name: 02124 · Dorchester, MA
findings: ZIP 02124 (Dorchester) has 222 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02124 (Dorchester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 9 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
